tools.name: kling_get_task
tools.description:
Query the status and result of a video generation task.

    Use this to check if a generation is complete and retrieve the resulting
    video URLs and other metadata.

    Use this when:
    - You want to check if a generation has completed
    - You need to retrieve video URLs from a previous generation
    - You want to get the full details of a generated video

    Task states:
    - 'pending': Generation is still in progress
    - 'completed': Generation finished successfully
    - 'failed': Generation failed (check error message)

    Returns:
        Task status and generated video information including URLs and state.

task_id.description: The task ID returned from a generation request. This is the 'task_id' field from any kling_generate_* or kling_extend_* tool response.
task_id.title: Task Id

tools.name: kling_get_tasks_batch
tools.description:
Query multiple video generation tasks at once.

    Efficiently check the status of multiple tasks in a single request.
    More efficient than calling kling_get_task multiple times.

    Use this when:
    - You have multiple pending generations to check
    - You want to get status of several videos at once
    - You're tracking a batch of generations

    Returns:
        Status and video information for all queried tasks.

task_ids.description: List of task IDs to query. Maximum recommended batch size is 50 tasks.
task_ids.title: Task Ids

tools.name: kling_generate_video
tools.description:
Generate AI video from a text prompt using Kling.

    This is the simplest way to create video - just describe what you want and Kling
    will generate a high-quality AI video.

    Use this when:
    - You want to create a video from a text description
    - You don't have reference images
    - You want quick video generation

    For using reference images (start/end frames), use kling_generate_video_from_image instead.

    Returns:
        Task ID and generated video information including URLs and state.

KlingCameraControlConfig.description: Numeric camera controls accepted by Kling's simple preset.
KlingCameraControlConfig.title: KlingCameraControlConfig

KlingReferenceImage.description: Omni reference image, optionally used as a first or end frame.
KlingReferenceImage.title: KlingReferenceImage

KlingReferenceVideo.description: Omni feature reference or editable base video.
KlingReferenceVideo.title: KlingReferenceVideo

prompt.description: Description of the video to generate. Be descriptive about the scene, motion, style, and mood. Examples: 'A cat walking through a garden with butterflies', 'Astronauts shuttle from space to volcano', 'Ocean waves crashing on a beach at sunset'
prompt.title: Prompt

model.description: Kling model to use. Options: 'kling-v1', 'kling-v1-6', 'kling-v2-master' (default), 'kling-v2-1-master', 'kling-v2-5-turbo', 'kling-v2-6', 'kling-v3', 'kling-v3-omni', 'kling-o1'.
model.title: Model

mode.description: Generation mode. 'std' (standard, default) for faster generation, 'pro' for higher quality, '4k' for native 4K (only supported by kling-v3 and kling-v3-omni, not compatible with motion control).
mode.title: Mode

aspect_ratio.description: Video aspect ratio. Options: '16:9' (landscape, default), '9:16' (portrait), '1:1' (square).
aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio

duration.description: Video duration in seconds. kling-v3/kling-v3-omni: 3-15; kling-o1: 5 only; other models: 5 or 10.
duration.title: Duration

generate_audio.description: Whether to generate audio synchronously. Supported by kling-v3, kling-v3-omni, and kling-v2-6 (pro mode only). Omit for the model default. Turbo always includes native audio.
generate_audio.title: Generate Audio

negative_prompt.description: Things to avoid in the video. Example: 'blurry, low quality, distorted faces'
negative_prompt.title: Negative Prompt

cfg_scale.description: Classifier-free guidance scale from 0 to 1. Not supported by Omni generation.
cfg_scale.title: Cfg Scale

camera_control.description: Structured camera control. Not supported by Omni generation.

image_list.description: Omni reference images for kling-o1 or kling-v3-omni. Cite them as <<<image_1>>>, <<<image_2>>>, and so on.

callback_url.description: Webhook callback URL for asynchronous notifications. When provided, the API will call this URL when the video is generated.

tools.name: kling_generate_video_from_image
tools.description:
Generate AI video using reference images as start and/or end frames.

    This allows you to control the video by specifying what the first frame
    and/or last frame should look like. Kling will generate smooth motion between them.

    Use this when:
    - You have a specific image you want to animate
    - You want to create a video transition between two images
    - You need precise control over the video's visual content

    start_image_url is required. end_image_url is optional.

    Returns:
        Task ID and generated video information including URLs and state.

KlingCameraControlConfig.description: Numeric camera controls accepted by Kling's simple preset.
KlingCameraControlConfig.title: KlingCameraControlConfig

KlingReferenceImage.description: Omni reference image, optionally used as a first or end frame.
KlingReferenceImage.title: KlingReferenceImage

KlingReferenceVideo.description: Omni feature reference or editable base video.
KlingReferenceVideo.title: KlingReferenceVideo

prompt.description: Description of the video motion and content. Describe what should happen in the video, how objects should move, what transitions to include.
prompt.title: Prompt

start_image_url.description: Required URL of the image to use as the first frame of the video.
start_image_url.title: Start Image Url

end_image_url.description: URL of the image to use as the last frame of the video. The video will animate towards this image.

model.description: Kling model to use. Default: 'kling-v2-master'.

mode.description: Generation mode. 'std' (standard, default), 'pro' (higher quality), or '4k' (native 4K, only for kling-v3 and kling-v3-omni).
mode.title: Mode

aspect_ratio.description: Video aspect ratio. Usually should match your input image ratio.
aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio

duration.description: Video duration in seconds. kling-v3/kling-v3-omni: 3-15; kling-o1: 5 only; other models: 5 or 10.
duration.title: Duration

generate_audio.description: Whether to generate audio synchronously. Supported by kling-v3, kling-v3-omni, and kling-v2-6 (pro mode only).
generate_audio.title: Generate Audio

negative_prompt.description: Things to avoid in the video.
negative_prompt.title: Negative Prompt

cfg_scale.description: Classifier-free guidance scale from 0 to 1. Not supported by Omni generation.
cfg_scale.title: Cfg Scale

camera_control.description: Structured camera control. Not supported by Omni generation.

image_list.description: Additional Omni reference images for kling-o1 or kling-v3-omni. Do not set type='first_frame' or 'end_frame' when the same frame is already supplied through start_image_url or end_image_url.

tools.name: kling_extend_video
tools.description:
Extend an existing video with additional content.

    This allows you to continue a previously generated video, adding more motion
    and content after the original video ends.

    Use this when:
    - A generated video is too short and you want to add more
    - You want to continue the story or motion from a previous video
    - You're building a longer video piece by piece

    Returns:
        Task ID and the extended video information.

video_id.description: ID of the video to extend. This is the 'video_id' field from a previous generation result.

model.description: Kling model to use. Default: 'kling-v2-master'.

mode.description: Generation mode. 'std' (standard, default), 'pro' (higher quality), or '4k' (native 4K, only for kling-v3 and kling-v3-omni).
mode.title: Mode

duration.description: Duration of the extended segment in seconds. Supports 5 or 10.
duration.title: Duration

negative_prompt.description: Things to avoid in the extended video.

List all available Kling API actions and corresponding tools.

    Reference guide for what each action does and which tool to use.
    Helpful for understanding the full capabilities of the Kling MCP.

    Returns:
        Categorized list of all actions and their corresponding tools.

tools.name: kling_lip_sync
tools.description:
Synchronize lip movements in a video to match a given audio track or text.

    Takes an existing video (by URL or task ID) and replaces the speaker's lip
    movements so they match the provided audio. In 'text2video' mode the audio
    is generated from the supplied text via TTS.

    Use this when:
    - You want to dub a video into a different language
    - You want to replace the audio of a generated video with custom speech
    - You want to create a talking-head video from text

    Returns:
        Task ID and lip-sync video information.

mode.description: Lip-sync mode. 'audio2video' to drive lips from an audio file or URL; 'text2video' to generate speech from text and drive the video.
mode.title: Mode

video_url.description: URL of the source video whose lip movements will be replaced. Provide either video_url or video_id.
video_url.title: Video Url

video_id.description: Task ID of a previously generated video to use as the source. Provide either video_url or video_id.
video_id.title: Video Id

audio_url.description: URL of the driving audio. Required when mode='audio2video' and audio_type='url'.
audio_url.title: Audio Url

audio_type.description: Audio source type. 'url' (default) to supply audio_url; 'file' to supply audio_file as a base64-encoded string.
audio_type.title: Audio Type

audio_file.description: Base64-encoded audio file content. Required when mode='audio2video' and audio_type='file'.
audio_file.title: Audio File

text.description: Text to convert to speech. Required when mode='text2video'.
text.title: Text

voice_id.description: Voice ID to use for text-to-speech synthesis (mode='text2video').
voice_id.title: Voice Id

voice_language.description: Language of the TTS voice. 'zh' for Chinese (default), 'en' for English. Used when mode='text2video'.
voice_language.title: Voice Language

voice_speed.description: Speech speed multiplier from 0.8 to 2.0 (default 1.0). Used when mode='text2video'.
voice_speed.title: Voice Speed

callback_url.description: Webhook URL that receives a POST when the lip-sync task completes.
callback_url.title: Callback Url

tools.name: kling_talking_photo
tools.description:
Animate a portrait photo to match a provided audio track (talking-photo).

    Given a face image and an audio file, generates a short video where the
    portrait's lips, expressions, and head movements are synchronized to the audio.

    Use this when:
    - You want to create a talking-head video from a static photo
    - You want to make a person in a photo appear to speak
    - You need a quick avatar video without real footage

    Returns:
        Task ID and talking-photo video information.

image_url.description: URL of the portrait image to animate. Should be a clear frontal face photo.
image_url.title: Image Url

audio_url.description: URL of the audio file that drives the talking animation.
audio_url.title: Audio Url

model.description: Kling model version. Default is 'kling-v2-1-master'. Options: kling-v1, kling-v1-6, kling-v2-master, kling-v2-1-master, kling-v2-5-turbo, kling-v2-6.
model.title: Model

duration.description: Video duration in seconds. Options: 5 (default) or 10.
duration.title: Duration

mode.description: Generation quality mode. 'pro' (default) for higher quality; 'std' for faster generation.
mode.title: Mode

prompt.description: Optional text description to guide the animation style or content.
prompt.title: Prompt

callback_url.description: Webhook URL that receives a POST when the talking-photo task completes.
callback_url.title: Callback Url

tools.name: kling_generate_motion
tools.description:
Transfer motion from a reference video to a character image.

    This tool enables character animation by extracting motion from a video
    and applying it to a static character image.

    Use this when:
    - You want to animate a character image using motion from a video
    - You want to create a dance or movement video from a still photo
    - You need to transfer specific movements to a character

    Returns:
        Task ID and motion generation information.

image_url.description: URL of the character image to animate. The character in this image will be animated with the motion from the reference video.
image_url.title: Image Url

video_url.description: URL of the reference video providing the motion. The character movements from this video will be transferred to the image.
video_url.title: Video Url

character_orientation.description: Orientation of the character. 'image' (default) uses the orientation from the character image, 'video' uses the orientation from the reference video.
character_orientation.title: Character Orientation

mode.description: Generation mode. 'std' (standard, default) for faster generation, 'pro' for higher quality.
mode.title: Mode

model_name.description: Optional Kling motion model name, such as 'kling-v2-6' or 'kling-v3'.
model_name.title: Model Name

prompt.description: Optional text description to guide the motion transfer. Use to add details about the desired output.
prompt.title: Prompt

keep_original_sound.description: Whether to keep the original sound from the reference video. Options: 'yes' or 'no'. Default depends on API.
keep_original_sound.title: Keep Original Sound

watermark_info.description: Optional watermark configuration forwarded to the API.

callback_url.description: Webhook callback URL for asynchronous notifications.
callback_url.title: Callback Url

tools.name: kling_generate_turbo_video
tools.description: Generate V3 Turbo 720p/1080p, 3–15 seconds. Native audio is included with no off switch. Poll kling_get_task.

tools.name: kling_generate_storyboard
tools.description: Generate V3/V3 Omni automatic or custom multishot video. Poll kling_get_task.

tools.name: kling_goods_studio
tools.description: Generate product studio video from ref_image and goods_title contents. Poll kling_get_task.

tools.name: kling_video_commerce
tools.description: Generate creator/product voiceover from an avatar and speech_script. Poll kling_get_task.

speech_rate.description: Supported speech rates: 0.8, 1.0, 1.2; unavailable for product voiceover.
speech_rate.title: Speech Rate

tools.name: kling_get_task
tools.description:
Query the status and result of a video generation task.

    Use this to check if a generation is complete and retrieve the resulting
    video URLs and other metadata.

    Use this when:
    - You want to check if a generation has completed
    - You need to retrieve video URLs from a previous generation
    - You want to get the full details of a generated video

    Task states:
    - 'pending': Generation is still in progress
    - 'completed': Generation finished successfully
    - 'failed': Generation failed (check error message)

    Returns:
        Task status and generated video information including URLs and state.

task_id.description: The task ID returned from a generation request. This is the 'task_id' field from any kling_generate_* or kling_extend_* tool response.
task_id.title: Task Id

tools.name: kling_get_tasks_batch
tools.description:
Query multiple video generation tasks at once.

    Efficiently check the status of multiple tasks in a single request.
    More efficient than calling kling_get_task multiple times.

    Use this when:
    - You have multiple pending generations to check
    - You want to get status of several videos at once
    - You're tracking a batch of generations

    Returns:
        Status and video information for all queried tasks.

task_ids.description: List of task IDs to query. Maximum recommended batch size is 50 tasks.
task_ids.title: Task Ids

tools.name: kling_generate_video
tools.description:
Generate AI video from a text prompt using Kling.

    This is the simplest way to create video - just describe what you want and Kling
    will generate a high-quality AI video.

    Use this when:
    - You want to create a video from a text description
    - You don't have reference images
    - You want quick video generation

    For using reference images (start/end frames), use kling_generate_video_from_image instead.

    Returns:
        Task ID and generated video information including URLs and state.

KlingCameraControlConfig.description: Numeric camera controls accepted by Kling's simple preset.
KlingCameraControlConfig.title: KlingCameraControlConfig

KlingReferenceImage.description: Omni reference image, optionally used as a first or end frame.
KlingReferenceImage.title: KlingReferenceImage

KlingReferenceVideo.description: Omni feature reference or editable base video.
KlingReferenceVideo.title: KlingReferenceVideo

prompt.description: Description of the video to generate. Be descriptive about the scene, motion, style, and mood. Examples: 'A cat walking through a garden with butterflies', 'Astronauts shuttle from space to volcano', 'Ocean waves crashing on a beach at sunset'
prompt.title: Prompt

model.description: Kling model to use. Options: 'kling-v1', 'kling-v1-6', 'kling-v2-master' (default), 'kling-v2-1-master', 'kling-v2-5-turbo', 'kling-v2-6', 'kling-v3', 'kling-v3-omni', 'kling-o1'.
model.title: Model

mode.description: Generation mode. 'std' (standard, default) for faster generation, 'pro' for higher quality, '4k' for native 4K (only supported by kling-v3 and kling-v3-omni, not compatible with motion control).
mode.title: Mode

aspect_ratio.description: Video aspect ratio. Options: '16:9' (landscape, default), '9:16' (portrait), '1:1' (square).
aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio

duration.description: Video duration in seconds. kling-v3/kling-v3-omni: 3-15; kling-o1: 5 only; other models: 5 or 10.
duration.title: Duration

generate_audio.description: Whether to generate audio synchronously. Supported by kling-v3, kling-v3-omni, and kling-v2-6 (pro mode only). Omit for the model default. Turbo always includes native audio.
generate_audio.title: Generate Audio

negative_prompt.description: Things to avoid in the video. Example: 'blurry, low quality, distorted faces'
negative_prompt.title: Negative Prompt

cfg_scale.description: Classifier-free guidance scale from 0 to 1. Not supported by Omni generation.
cfg_scale.title: Cfg Scale

camera_control.description: Structured camera control. Not supported by Omni generation.

image_list.description: Omni reference images for kling-o1 or kling-v3-omni. Cite them as <<<image_1>>>, <<<image_2>>>, and so on.
image_list.title: Image List

video_list.description: One Omni reference video for kling-o1 or kling-v3-omni. Cite it as <<<video_1>>>. Use refer_type='feature' to reference it or 'base' to edit it.
video_list.title: Video List

callback_url.description: Webhook callback URL for asynchronous notifications. When provided, the API will call this URL when the video is generated.
callback_url.title: Callback Url

tools.name: kling_generate_video_from_image
tools.description:
Generate AI video using reference images as start and/or end frames.

    This allows you to control the video by specifying what the first frame
    and/or last frame should look like. Kling will generate smooth motion between them.

    Use this when:
    - You have a specific image you want to animate
    - You want to create a video transition between two images
    - You need precise control over the video's visual content

    start_image_url is required. end_image_url is optional.

    Returns:
        Task ID and generated video information including URLs and state.

KlingCameraControlConfig.description: Numeric camera controls accepted by Kling's simple preset.
KlingCameraControlConfig.title: KlingCameraControlConfig

KlingReferenceImage.description: Omni reference image, optionally used as a first or end frame.
KlingReferenceImage.title: KlingReferenceImage

KlingReferenceVideo.description: Omni feature reference or editable base video.
KlingReferenceVideo.title: KlingReferenceVideo

prompt.description: Description of the video motion and content. Describe what should happen in the video, how objects should move, what transitions to include.
prompt.title: Prompt

start_image_url.description: Required URL of the image to use as the first frame of the video.
start_image_url.title: Start Image Url

end_image_url.description: URL of the image to use as the last frame of the video. The video will animate towards this image.
end_image_url.title: End Image Url

model.description: Kling model to use. Default: 'kling-v2-master'.
model.title: Model

mode.description: Generation mode. 'std' (standard, default), 'pro' (higher quality), or '4k' (native 4K, only for kling-v3 and kling-v3-omni).
mode.title: Mode

aspect_ratio.description: Video aspect ratio. Usually should match your input image ratio.
aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio

duration.description: Video duration in seconds. kling-v3/kling-v3-omni: 3-15; kling-o1: 5 only; other models: 5 or 10.
duration.title: Duration

generate_audio.description: Whether to generate audio synchronously. Supported by kling-v3, kling-v3-omni, and kling-v2-6 (pro mode only).
generate_audio.title: Generate Audio

negative_prompt.description: Things to avoid in the video.
negative_prompt.title: Negative Prompt

cfg_scale.description: Classifier-free guidance scale from 0 to 1. Not supported by Omni generation.
cfg_scale.title: Cfg Scale

camera_control.description: Structured camera control. Not supported by Omni generation.

image_list.description: Additional Omni reference images for kling-o1 or kling-v3-omni. Do not set type='first_frame' or 'end_frame' when the same frame is already supplied through start_image_url or end_image_url.
image_list.title: Image List

video_list.description: One Omni reference video for kling-o1 or kling-v3-omni.
video_list.title: Video List

callback_url.description: Webhook callback URL for asynchronous notifications.
callback_url.title: Callback Url

tools.name: kling_extend_video
tools.description:
Extend an existing video with additional content.

    This allows you to continue a previously generated video, adding more motion
    and content after the original video ends.

    Use this when:
    - A generated video is too short and you want to add more
    - You want to continue the story or motion from a previous video
    - You're building a longer video piece by piece

    Returns:
        Task ID and the extended video information.

video_id.description: ID of the video to extend. This is the 'video_id' field from a previous generation result.
video_id.title: Video Id

prompt.description: Description of what should happen in the extended portion of the video. Describe the continuation of motion and new content.
prompt.title: Prompt

model.description: Kling model to use. Default: 'kling-v2-master'.
model.title: Model

mode.description: Generation mode. 'std' (standard, default), 'pro' (higher quality), or '4k' (native 4K, only for kling-v3 and kling-v3-omni).
mode.title: Mode

duration.description: Duration of the extended segment in seconds. Supports 5 or 10.
duration.title: Duration

negative_prompt.description: Things to avoid in the extended video.
negative_prompt.title: Negative Prompt

callback_url.description: Optional webhook URL for asynchronous result notification.
callback_url.title: Callback Url

Query the status and result of a video generation task.

Use this to check if a generation is complete and retrieve the resulting
video URLs and other metadata.

Use this when:
- You want to check if a generation has completed
- You need to retrieve video URLs from a previous generation
- You want to get the full details of a generated video

Task states:
- 'queued' or 'running': Generation is still in progress
- 'succeeded': Generation finished successfully
- 'failed' or 'cancelled': Generation reached a terminal error state

Returns:
    Task status and generated video information including URLs and status.

tools.name: seedream_generate_image
tools.description:
Generate an AI image from a text prompt using ByteDance's Seedream model.

    This tool creates high-quality images from text descriptions using ByteDance's
    Seedream models (powered by Doubao). Supports multiple model versions with different
    capabilities and quality levels.

    Use this when:
    - You want to generate a new image from scratch based on a text description
    - You need high-quality AI-generated images (photos, illustrations, art)
    - You want to create images with specific styles, compositions, or themes

    Do NOT use this when:
    - You want to edit or modify an existing image (use seedream_edit_image instead)
    - You need to combine multiple images (use seedream_edit_image instead)

    Model selection guide:
    - v5.0 Lite (doubao-seedream-5-0-lite-260128): Image sets, streaming, and web search
    - v4.5 (doubao-seedream-4-5-251128): Previous flagship, great quality and detail
    - v4.0 (doubao-seedream-4-0-250828): Stable and cost-effective, great for most tasks
    Returns:
        JSON with task_id, trace_id, success status, and generated image data
        including image URLs.

prompt.description: Description of the image to generate. Be descriptive about subject, style, atmosphere, lighting, and composition. Supports both Chinese and English. Example: 'A photorealistic portrait of an astronaut on Mars, golden hour lighting, cinematic composition, ultra-detailed'
prompt.title: Prompt

model.description: Model to use for generation. 'doubao-seedream-5-0-pro-260628' (v5.0 Pro, flagship single image, highest quality; no sequential generation, streaming, or web search). 'doubao-seedream-5-0-lite-260128' (v5.0 Lite, sequential generation, streaming, web search). 'doubao-seedream-4-5-251128' (v4.5, previous flagship, great quality). 'doubao-seedream-4-0-250828' (v4.0, stable, best value).
model.title: Model

size.description: Model-specific output size: Pro supports 1K/1.5K/2K (and auto for decomposition); Lite supports 2K/3K/4K. Explicit dimensions such as 2048x1024 are also accepted.
size.title: Size

sequential_image_generation.description: Generate related images based on input. 'auto' enables it, 'disabled' (default) turns it off. Supported by Seedream 5.0 Lite, 4.5, and 4.0; not Pro.
sequential_image_generation.title: Sequential Image Generation

sequential_image_generation_options.description: Tunable options for grouped image generation. Only honored when `sequential_image_generation=auto`. Supports `max_images` (int, range [1, 15]). Supported by Seedream 5.0 Lite, 4.5, and 4.0; not Pro.
sequential_image_generation_options.title: Sequential Image Generation Options

response_format.description: Response format for the generated image. 'url' (default) returns a public image URL. 'b64_json' returns base64-encoded image data.
response_format.title: Response Format

watermark.description: Whether to add an AI-generated watermark. Default is true.
watermark.title: Watermark

callback_url.description: Optional webhook URL to receive the result asynchronously. The API will POST the result to this URL when complete. Must be publicly accessible.
callback_url.title: Callback Url

tools.description: Optional list of tool types for the model to use during generation. Currently only 'web_search' is supported. Only supported by doubao-seedream-5-0-lite-260128 (v5.0 Lite).
tools.title: Tools

optimize_prompt_options.title: Optimize Prompt Options

tools.name: seedream_edit_image

Edit or modify existing images using ByteDance's Seedream/SeedEdit model.

    This tool modifies existing images based on text instructions. It can change
    styles, backgrounds, attributes, clothing, and more. Supports single or
    multiple image inputs.

    Use this when:
    - You want to modify or transform an existing image
    - You need to change style, background, colors, or attributes
    - You want to apply artistic transformations (watercolor, oil painting, etc.)
    - You need virtual try-on (clothing on person)
    - You want to place objects in different scenes

    Common use cases:
    - Style transfer: "Convert to anime style", "Make it look like a pencil sketch"
    - Background change: "Replace background with a sunset beach"
    - Attribute edit: "Change hair color to blonde", "Add sunglasses"
    - Virtual try-on: Provide person image + clothing image

    Seedream models (powered by Doubao). Supports multiple model versions with different

    - You need high-quality AI-generated images (photos, illustrations, art)

tools.name: flux_generate_image
tools.description:
Generate AI images from a text prompt using Flux.

    Flux is a family of fast, high-quality image generation models by Black Forest Labs.
    Different models offer different tradeoffs between speed, quality, and capabilities.

    Use this when:
    - You want to create new images from a text description
    - You need high-quality AI-generated artwork or photos
    - You want fast image generation with good prompt following

    For editing existing images, use flux_edit_image instead.

    Returns:
        Task ID and generated image information including URLs.

prompt.description: Description of the image to generate. Be descriptive about style, subject, lighting, and composition. Examples: 'A majestic mountain landscape at golden hour, photorealistic', 'Cyberpunk street scene with neon lights and rain, cinematic', 'Minimalist logo design of a phoenix, vector art style'
prompt.title: Prompt

size.description: Required image size. For flux-dev: pixel dimensions like '1024x1024' (256-1440px, multiples of 32). For flux-2-flex/pro/max: pixel dimensions (x >= 64, multiples of 32). For kontext models: image ratios like '1:1', '16:9', '9:16', '4:3', '3:2', '2:3', '4:5', '5:4', '3:4', '21:9', '9:21'.
size.title: Size

model.description:
Flux model to use for generation. Options:
- flux-dev: Fast development model, good balance of speed and quality (default)
- flux-pro: Higher quality production model
- flux-2-flex: Flux 2 flexible model, pixel sizes (x >= 64, multiple of 32)
- flux-2-pro: Flux 2 professional model, high quality
- flux-2-max: Flux 2 maximum-quality model
- flux-2-klein: Flux 2 klein model, efficient generation
- flux-kontext-pro: Context-aware model for editing and style transfer
- flux-kontext-max: Maximum context model for complex editing tasks
model.title: Model

count.description: Number of images to generate. Only supported for generate action. Default is 1.
count.title: Count

callback_url.description: Webhook callback URL for asynchronous notifications. When provided, the API will POST to this URL when the image is generated.
callback_url.title: Callback Url

tools.description:
Edit an existing image using Flux with a text prompt.

    This allows you to modify an existing image based on a text description.
    The kontext models (flux-kontext-pro, flux-kontext-max) are specifically
    designed for high-quality image editing and style transfer.

    Use this when:
    - You want to modify or transform an existing image
    - You want to change specific elements in an image
    - You want to apply style changes or artistic effects
    - You want to add, remove, or replace objects in an image

    For generating new images from scratch, use flux_generate_image instead.

    Returns:
        Task ID and edited image information including URLs.

image_url.description: URL of the image to edit. Must be a direct image URL (JPEG, PNG, etc.), not a web page containing an image.
image_url.title: Image Url

size.description: Required output image size. For kontext models: aspect ratios like '1:1', '16:9'. For other models: pixel dimensions like '1024x1024'.
size.title: Size

model.description:
Flux model to use for editing. Recommended models for editing:
- flux-kontext-pro: Best for context-aware editing and style transfer (recommended)
- flux-kontext-max: Maximum context for complex edits
- flux-dev: Basic editing support
Other models also support editing but kontext models give best results.

source_tools.name: flux_generate_image
source_tools.description:
Generate AI images from a text prompt using Flux.

Flux is a family of fast, high-quality image generation models by Black Forest Labs.
Different models offer different tradeoffs between speed, quality, and capabilities.

Use this when:
- You want to create new images from a text description
- You need high-quality AI-generated artwork or photos
- You want fast image generation with good prompt following

For editing existing images, use flux_edit_image instead.

Returns:
    Task ID and generated image information including URLs.

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.annotation: Annotated[str, Field(description="Description of the image to generate. Be descriptive about style, subject, lighting, and composition. Examples: 'A majestic mountain landscape at golden hour, photorealistic', 'Cyberpunk street scene with neon lights and rain, cinematic', 'Minimalist logo design of a phoenix, vector art style'")]

parameters.name: model
parameters.annotation:
Annotated[FluxModel, Field(description='Flux model to use for generation. Options:
- flux-dev: Fast development model, good balance of speed and quality (default)
- flux-pro: Higher quality production model
- flux-2-flex: Flux 2 flexible model, pixel sizes (x >= 64, multiple of 32)
- flux-2-pro: Flux 2 professional model, high quality
- flux-2-max: Flux 2 maximum-quality model
- flux-2-klein: Flux 2 klein model, efficient generation
- flux-kontext-pro: Context-aware model for editing and style transfer
- flux-kontext-max: Maximum context model for complex editing tasks')]

parameters.name: size
parameters.annotation: Annotated[str | None, Field(description="Image size. For flux-dev: pixel dimensions like '1024x1024' (256-1440px, multiples of 32). For flux-2-flex/pro/max: pixel dimensions (x >= 64, multiples of 32). For kontext models: image ratios like '1:1', '16:9', '9:16', '4:3', '3:2', '2:3', '4:5', '5:4', '3:4', '21:9', '9:21'. Default varies by model.")]

source_tools.name: flux_edit_image
source_tools.description:
Edit an existing image using Flux with a text prompt.

This allows you to modify an existing image based on a text description.
The kontext models (flux-kontext-pro, flux-kontext-max) are specifically
designed for high-quality image editing and style transfer.

Use this when:
- You want to modify or transform an existing image
- You want to change specific elements in an image
- You want to apply style changes or artistic effects
- You want to add, remove, or replace objects in an image

For generating new images from scratch, use flux_generate_image instead.

Returns:
    Task ID and edited image information including URLs.

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.annotation: Annotated[str, Field(description="Description of how to edit the image. Be specific about what changes to make. Examples: 'Change the background to a sunset beach', 'Add sunglasses to the person', 'Make it look like a watercolor painting', 'Replace the car with a bicycle'")]

parameters.name: image_url
parameters.annotation: Annotated[str, Field(description='URL of the image to edit. Must be a direct image URL (JPEG, PNG, etc.), not a web page containing an image.')]

parameters.annotation:
Annotated[FluxModel, Field(description='Flux model to use for editing. Recommended models for editing:
- flux-kontext-pro: Best for context-aware editing and style transfer (recommended)
- flux-kontext-max: Maximum context for complex edits
- flux-dev: Basic editing support
Other models also support editing but kontext models give best results.')]

parameters.name: size
parameters.annotation: Annotated[str | None, Field(description="Output image size. For kontext models: aspect ratios like '1:1', '16:9'. For other models: pixel dimensions like '1024x1024'.")]

source_tools.name: flux_get_task
source_tools.description:
Query the status and result of a Flux image generation task.

Use this to check if a generation is complete and retrieve the resulting
image URLs and metadata.

Use this when:
- You want to check if an image generation has completed
- You need to retrieve image URLs from a previous generation
- You used async callback and want to check results later
- The initial generation returned a task_id without immediate results

Returns:
    Task status and generation result including image URLs.
